app.name: NullDC4Wii alpha 0.67
app.coder: Xale00, Skmp, NulldcTeam, Joseph Jordan, Team, AI
app.long_description:
NullDC4Wii is an attempt to port NullDC for Wii. More info : https://github.com/BenoitAdam/nullDC4Wii Compatiblity guide : https://wiibrew.org/wiki/NullDC4Wii/Compatibility
Runs from SD or USB. Put the bios in the data/ folder next to boot.dol, i.e. sd:/apps/nulldc4wii/data/ or usb:/apps/nulldc4wii/data/. Put games in sd:/discs/ or usb:/dreamcast/ (either name works on either device). Press 2 in the file browser to switch device.
